# Implement the next vertical slice

## Context

Read before doing anything:

- the project instructions and generated skills in this repository;
- `docs/REPLATFORM_ANALYSIS.md` — what the product must do;
- `docs/BOOTSTRAP_HANDOFF.md` — how this project was created, what was verified, what is unresolved.

The source product stays available at `/home/egorrko/code/elixir/tg_voice_showcase/telegram_voice_transciber` and is the authority on existing behavior. Read it whenever the analysis is thin, and never guess at behavior a source file can answer.

## 1. Choose the slice

Use `$ARGUMENTS` when the user named a slice.

Otherwise take the first slice in `docs/REPLATFORM_ANALYSIS.md` that is not marked done: the first run takes the one recorded in the handoff, later runs continue down the analysis.

Confirm the choice in one line before implementing, and stop to ask only if the analysis leaves a decision that changes what gets built.

## 2. Implement it end to end

A slice is user-visible start to user-visible finish. It is not a layer.

- Ash domains, resources, actions, policies, calculations, and validations for the behavior;
- migrations, generated through the Ash tooling rather than hand-written;
- the LiveView route, mount, and authoritative state;
- the LiveVue components for every screen this slice touches;
- tests covering the behavior and the authorization rules, not only the happy path;
- seeds or fixtures when the slice needs data to be visible.

Deterministic business rules stay in deterministic Elixir. Follow `STACK_POLICY` decisions already recorded in the analysis rather than reopening them.

## 3. Verify

```bash
mix format
mix compile --warnings-as-errors
mix test
```

Then boot the development server and exercise the slice through the actual UI path, not only through tests.

Rebuild the release and Docker image when the slice touched assets, configuration, runtime environment, or dependencies. Record every result as passed, failed, or not verified with the reason.

## 4. Record and commit

- Mark the slice done in `docs/REPLATFORM_ANALYSIS.md`, and add anything the implementation uncovered that the analysis missed.
- Add new open questions to `docs/BOOTSTRAP_HANDOFF.md`; remove the ones this slice answered.
- Commit the slice with the verification results in the message body.

Report what was built, what was verified, what was not, and what the next slice is.
